results.question: What is the average product price in each category? Show the category name and average price in kopecks, rounded to the nearest integer.

WITH category_avg_price AS (
    SELECT
        c.name AS category_name,
        CAST(AVG(p.price_cents) AS INTEGER) AS average_price_cents
    FROM
        products p
    JOIN
        categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    GROUP BY
        c.name
)
SELECT
    category_name,
    average_price_cents
FROM
    category_avg_price;

results.question: What is the total order discount for each coupon? Show the coupon code and discount total in kopecks, only for coupons that were used.
results.initial_sql:
WITH used_coupons AS (
    SELECT coupon_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE coupon_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY coupon_id
)
SELECT 
    c.code AS coupon_code,
    SUM(o.discount_cents) AS total_discount_cents
FROM 
    coupons c
JOIN 
    used_coupons uc ON c.coupon_id = uc.coupon_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.coupon_id = o.coupon_id
GROUP BY 
    c.coupon_id, c.code;
